Hawaii Commercial Foods serves both retail and food-service customers, supplying grocery stores, restaurants, and direct consumers through an online store.
Its products are positioned as authentic Korean pantry staples for the Hawaiian market and beyond.
The business emphasizes its generational recipe and handcrafted approach as its primary differentiators, distinguishing its offerings from mass-produced alternatives.
